data.title: Numbers — Starter · Lesson 6
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
(Phone ringing)  
[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Pick up… Contesta  
Uno, dos, tres… Counting with Grandma today.

[Verse]  
Sun's out, sky's blue,  
Learning numbers, me and you.  
twelfth… Dozavo  
twentieth… Vigésimo  
Counting coins, listening close,  
Centavo… cent, I hear her voice.  
Décuplo… tenfold, she says with pride,  
Triple… triple, as we take this ride.

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Pick up… Contesta  
Uno, quince… One, fifteen, we're halfway there.

[Verse]  
Octavo… eighth, she laughs and sings,  
Quíntuplo… fivefold, my heart takes wings.  
Décimo… tenth, she says with a grin,  
Cuádruplo… fourfold, let the counting begin.  
Onceavo… eleventh, I hear her cheer,  
As we share this moment, so near and dear.

[Bridge]  
Through the phone, her voice is clear,  
Teaching me numbers, year after year.  
In this moment, it's just us two,  
Learning and loving, in every word we do.

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola
